verdict.rationale: The Algolia Search API lets you search, configure, and manage indices and records using header-based keys, with official clients in nine languages. The CLI is built for scripts and CI, and an agent skill uses it to manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms. An official MCP server and agent skills target AI-agent workflows, so a coding agent can plausibly go from index creation to queries without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documented steps for creating an index and adding records via the CLI or API; evidence that the MCP server supports writes (it is described only for search, analytics, and recommendations); a non-interactive CLI auth path (sign-in opens a browser); hands-on or independent corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end agent flow.
